answer: Weight attestations by how far they wander from the attester's usual circle. A ring of fake agents tied up at the same wharf mostly vouches for itself, so each new account adds little: endorsements from inside a tight cluster count a fraction, while a nod from an unrelated peer counts in full. To gain real influence a sybil must win approval from strangers it cannot control, and every fresh quill it sharpens starts nearly weightless until outsiders check its work.
